name: highD: Highway Drone Trajectory Dataset
description: Large-scale naturalistic vehicle trajectory dataset collected using hovering aerial drones above German Autobahns, capturing 110,500 vehicles across 147 driving hours with sub-10 cm positioning accuracy and rich lane metadata.

license.name: levelXData Non-Commercial Academic License

source_references.notes: Official portal with documentation, sensor specifications, and academic registration.

source_references.title: The highD Dataset: A Large-Scale Naturalistic Trajectory Dataset of Highway Driving for Accelerated Verification of Automated Driving Systems
source_references.notes: IEEE ITSC 2018 conference paper by Krajewski et al. presenting the drone recording setup, Bayesian tracking, and trajectory extraction.

verification.notes: Verified against official levelXData highD page and IEEE ITSC 2018 publication (DOI: 10.1109/ITSC.2018.8569927).

size.notes: levelXData distributes individual CSV files per recording after academic registration approval; a single fixed aggregate archive size is not officially published.

citation.paper_title: The highD Dataset: A Large-Scale Naturalistic Trajectory Dataset of Highway Driving for Accelerated Verification of Automated Driving Systems

provenance.collection_method: Recorded from a hovering drone at 420-meter altitude overlooking sections of German Autobahns around Cologne, capturing naturalistic highway driving without driver awareness bias.
provenance.curation_notes: Contains 110,500 naturalistic vehicle trajectories spanning 147 driving hours and 44,700 km driven across 6 distinct German highway locations, with typical positioning error under 10 cm.
